items.title: Manuel Joseph "Moose" Zanco Interview, 1959-11-25
items.q: I have, uh, a recording horn by George Lewis... I liked... George Lewis. I think I like them all.

ctx.x: He always made all the jobs.

He always made all the jobs, yeah, unfortunately. Because I didn't want to get in and play, you know, more than I actually did. But, uh, I would go and listen to him, you know. I'd go up to Bruno's and listen to him play. And, uh, uh, uh, Briss, Briss Jones, the clarinetist, he played with this, uh, group we had up in Kenna years ago. You know, he sat in with us a couple of times. And, uh, he told John Chaff, he told John, he says, uh, he said, well, you know, Moose plays a con-ed. So, John asked me if I would…
Well, what do you play at other than Bruno's? What other places?
